translations.en: and I do feel sorry for her, but business is business.
You have to pay what you owe.
Waaaaaaaah!
Talk about adding insult to injury!
I'm never dreaming of being the savior again!
As your reward, @7rFiore@0r reluctantly handed you @3r8,801 G@0r and
a @3rBalmar Guard@0r.
From now on, I'll work hard and earn an honest living!
No chance. Tomorrow you'll be dreaming of getting rich quick again.
Am I doomed to be a loser forever?!
Why was I born under such an unlucky star?!
Somebody heeeeelp me!
As your reward, @7rFiore@0r gave you @3r8,801 G@0r,
though she was very reluctant to hand it over.
Anyway, let's find that trapezoid tablet in upper @6rGraham Labyrinth@0r!
Come on, get to work for your future savior!
You coward!
Are you that unhappy about me becoming the savior?
Or have you changed your mind about helping?
You have, haven't you? Right? Right? Riiiight?
See? Those who believe shall be saved!
@7rCarmine@0r and the others who didn't believe
will go down in history as fools who doubted the savior.
Who's supposed to be the savior?!
M-E!
Don't come crying to me later!
Anyway, here's the rumor I heard.
"Break the trapezoid tablet in the upper levels of @6rGraham Labyrinth@0r
to make three triangles and one large triangle."
Anyway, let's find that tablet in @6rGraham@0r Labyrinth!
Oh, come on! A hero can't be so reluctant!
Please? Please? Pleeease?! Let's have an adventure!
Come on, it'll be fine!
We might be able to save the world, you know!
Let's try anything that has a chance of working! Okay?
No? Seriously? You're really saying no?
It's no, no, no, is it?! Honestly!
When you failed to give her the answer she wanted,
@7rFiore@0r stomped off in a huff.
Hey, hey, hey! Listen! Listen to me already!
I've found another way to save this town!
Another way to save the town?
At those words, everyone present suddenly perked up.
Deep in @6rGraham Labyrinth@0r, there's a sealed jar
that's supposed to grant any wish!
Oh, that old story.
People have been saying that for ages,
but wasn't it supposed to be pretty dubious?
Yes. There aren't any concrete clues or anything.
Even I know that!
But what if I told you I'd got hold of that crucial information?
...What would you say?
Don't worry. That information's dubious too...
What?! You didn't even hesitate!
It's not dubious, I tell you!
It's worth investigating! Right? Right? Come on!
Hey, you believe me, don't you?
Come and investigate it with me!
At times like this, you're supposed to clutch at straws, right?!
Anyway, let's find that tablet in @6rGraham@0r Labyrinth!!
Aaaaah! What do you think you're doing?!
Go away! Get away from me! Stay baaaaack!
H-hey! Watch where you're touching me!
You turned at the piercing screams
to see a group carrying a bound @7rFiore@0r
as they hurried into the darkness of the ruins.
Oh, no! Oh, no!
This time it's a real kidnapping!
They've taken @7rFiore@0r away!
